```{r}
library(quantmod)

```

```{r}
# Download WTI Crude Oil spot price series from FRED
getSymbols("DCOILWTICO", src = "FRED", from="2024-01-01")

#Remove NA values
oil_data=na.omit(DCOILWTICO)

#Data frame 
oil_df=data.frame(
  Date=as.Date(index(oil_data)),
  Price=as.numeric(oil_data$DCOILWTICO)
)

tail(oil_df)
```

# DMA
```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}

# -- explanatory variables

# Extract Nominal Broad USD index 
getSymbols("DTWEXBGS", src = "FRED", from = "2024-01-01")
us_index=na.omit(DTWEXBGS)

us_df=data.frame(
  Date=as.Date(index(us_index)), 
  Index=as.numeric(us_index$DTWEXBGS)
)
tail(us_df)

#### Match rows by date
merging_xts= merge(oil_df, us_df, join="inner")
tail(merging_xts)


#----- Need Data team to get the API keys for the following data:

# Extract Inventory
#inventory=read.csv("https://api.eia.gov/v2/petroleum/stoc/cu/data/?frequency=monthly&data[0]=value&start=2024-01&sort[0][column]=period&sort[0][direction]=desc&offset=0&length=5000")
set.seed(111)
inventory=rnorm(n=length(merging_xts$Price), mean=434.5, sd=15.8)

# Spare capacity 
spare_capacity=rnorm(n=length(merging_xts$Price), mean=2.82, sd= 1.76)
#--------------


# ------ Exogenous variable/s ------------
hormuz_tm=rnorm(n=length(merging_xts$Price), mean=20, sd=15)

# -------- Let Y=oil prices ---------
Y = merging_xts$Price

# ------- Create matrix
oil_matrix=matrix(c(merging_xts$Index, inventory, spare_capacity), ncol=3)
colnames(oil_matrix)=c("USD index", "Oil Inventory", "Spare Capacity")


#DMA
oil_dma= fDMA(
  y=Y, 
  x=oil_matrix, 
  alpha=0.99, 
  lambda=0.90, 
  initvar = 10
)
summary(oil_dma)

real_dma=oil_dma$y
predicted_dma=oil_dma$y.hat

plot(real_dma, type="l", col="black") 
lines(predicted_dma, col="steelblue", lwd=2)
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Real values", "Predicted values"), 
       col=c("black", "steelblue"), 
       lty=1)

```

# VECM
```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
vecm_matrix=matrix(c(Y, merging_xts$Index, inventory, spare_capacity), ncol=4)
colnames(vecm_matrix)=c("Crude Oil Price in USD", "USD index", 
                        "Oil Inventory", "Spare Capacity")
head(vecm_matrix)

lagselect=VARselect(vecm_matrix, lag.max = 30)
lagselect$selection
lagselect$criteria

#K=5

# ---- cointegration tests ----
ctest1=ca.jo(vecm_matrix, type="trace", ecdet="const", K=5 )
summary(ctest1)

ctest1e=ca.jo(vecm_matrix, type="eigen", ecdet="const", K=5 )
summary(ctest1)

#cointegration detected, r=1


# ---- VECM model ----
library(tsDyn)
ModelVECM1= VECM(vecm_matrix, 
                 5, 
                 r=1, 
                 estim="2OLS")
summary(ModelVECM1)

vecm_fc=predict(ModelVECM1, n.ahead = 90)
plot(vecm_fc, type="l")


# Second VECM model taking into account oil flow disruptions

ModelVECM2= VECM(vecm_matrix, 
                 5, 
                 r=1, 
                 estim="2OLS", 
                 exogen = matrix(hormuz_tm, ncol=1))
summary(ModelVECM2)

#adding millions of barrels going through the Strait of Hormuz scenarios
hormuz_1=matrix(rnorm(n=180, mean=6, sd=1)) #current
hormuz_2=matrix(rnorm(n=180, mean=20, sd=3)) #previous
hormuz_3=matrix(rnorm(n=180, mean=1, sd=0.5)) #worst-case

vecm_fc_1=predict(ModelVECM2, n.ahead = 180, exoPred = hormuz_1)
vecm_fc_2=predict(ModelVECM2, n.ahead = 180, exoPred = hormuz_2)
vecm_fc_3=predict(ModelVECM2, n.ahead = 180, exoPred = hormuz_3)

# Combine predictions into a single plot
matplot(
  cbind(vecm_fc_1[, 1], vecm_fc_2[, 1], vecm_fc_3[, 1]),
  type = "l", lty = 1, lwd=2, col = c("steelblue", "green2", "orange"),
  xlab = "Forecast horizon (days)",
  ylab = "Crude oil price",
  main = "Oil Price Forecasts under different Strait 
  of Hormuz Crude Oil Flow Scenarios"
)

legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = c("Current scenario: mean 6", "Best case scenario: mean 20", 
             "Worst case scenario: mean 1"),
  col = c("steelblue", "green2", "orange"), lty = 1
)
```

# VECM to VAR
```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
## ------ Diagnostic Tests --------
# ---- Transform VECM to VAR ----
Model1VAR=vec2var(ctest1, r=1)
Model1VAR

var_fc=predict(Model1VAR, n.ahead = 90)
plot(var_fc, type="l")

# ---- Serial correlation ----
serial1=serial.test(Model1VAR, lags.pt = 6, type="PT.asymptotic")
serial1

# ---- ARCH effects (clustered volatility) ----
arch1=arch.test(Model1VAR, lags.single = 15, multivariate.only =TRUE)
arch1

# ---- Normality of residuals ----
norm1=normality.test(Model1VAR, multivariate.only = TRUE)
norm1
```

## IRF
```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# ---- Impulse Response Functions -----
library(vars)
library(urca)
wholthing=irf(Model1VAR, n.ahead=30)
plot(wholthing)

Indexirf= irf.vec2var(Model1VAR, impulse="USD.index", response="Crude.Oil.Price.in.USD", n.ahead = 30,  boot=TRUE)

plot(Indexirf, main="Crude Oil Prices shock to a one-unit increase in the Nominal Broad USD Index")

inventoryirf= irf(Model1VAR, impulse="Oil.Inventory", response="Crude.Oil.Price.in.USD", n.ahead = 30,  boot=TRUE)
plot(inventoryirf, main="Crude Oil Prices shock to a one-unit increase in the Oil Inventory")

spareirf=irf(Model1VAR, impulse="Spare.Capacity", response="Crude.Oil.Price.in.USD", n.ahead = 30,  boot=TRUE)
plot(inventoryirf, main="Crude Oil Prices shock to a one-unit increase in Spare Capacity")

invtospareirf=irf(Model1VAR, impulse="Spare.Capacity", response="Oil.Inventory", n.ahead = 30,  boot=TRUE)
plot(invtospareirf, main="Oil Inventory shock to a one-unit increase the Spare Capacity")

# ---- Variance decomposition ----

FEVD1=fevd(Model1VAR, n.ahead=20)
plot(FEVD1)

```
